candidates.researchQuestion: What evidence should a digital-employee runtime require before publishing an externally visible Running state?
candidates.title: Running Is an Evidence Claim, Not a Scheduler Event
candidates.title_zh: “运行中”是一项证据声明，不是调度事件
candidates.coreProposition: An externally visible Running state should be published only after the runtime holds evidence sufficient for the execution-readiness semantics its consumers rely on; scheduling, assignment and worker claim must remain distinguishable from readiness, and the demonstrated process-start boundary does not prove full health.

sections.heading: A status becomes an interface contract when it triggers behavior
sections.heading_zh: 状态一旦触发行为，就成为接口合同

sections.heading: Separate the facts consumers tend to collapse
sections.heading_zh: 把容易混淆的事实拆成证据阶梯

sections.heading: Derive the readiness gate from the consumer promise
sections.heading_zh: 从消费者承诺反推就绪门槛

sections.heading: The boundary matters more than a louder conclusion
sections.heading_zh: 已知边界比更响亮的结论更重要

evidenceClaims.claim: Anthropic published Claude Code v2.1.247 with a release-note entry for the affected self-hosted runner state behavior.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Code 2.1.247，并记录了受影响的自托管运行器状态问题。

evidenceClaims.claim: Anthropic reports that affected sessions could report running before Claude Code started and could trigger a premature desktop notification.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Anthropic 报告称，受影响会话可能在 Claude Code 启动前报告“运行中”，并触发过早的桌面通知。

evidenceClaims.claim: The release note describes the fix as preventing the affected Running report from preceding process startup.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 发布说明将修复描述为阻止受影响的“运行中”报告早于进程启动。

evidenceClaims.claim: Consumer-visible Running should be evidence-backed execution readiness rather than scheduling, assignment or claim alone.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 面向消费者的“运行中”应是有证据支撑的执行就绪，而不能只是调度、分配或认领。

evidenceClaims.claim: Process startup is a bounded ordering fact and does not establish full health or universal readiness.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 进程启动只是有界的顺序事实，不能建立完整健康或通用就绪。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general runtime-state truth.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable state-evidence pattern; a separate edition would repeat the same evidence.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should an agent platform carry account-derived authority evidence to tools without allowing the requester to forge, widen or reuse stale authority?
candidates.title: Authority Context Must Be Minted by the Host
candidates.title_zh: 权限上下文必须由宿主生成
candidates.coreProposition: Authority-bearing access context should be minted by the host that can verify the governing identity, should replace caller-supplied copies, and should cross only an explicitly qualified capability edge; unverifiable state must collapse to a non-authorizing result, while downstream enforcement remains a separate obligation.

sections.heading: The requester cannot issue its own authority evidence
sections.heading_zh: 请求者不能同时签发自己的权限证据

sections.heading: Capability scope is a conjunction, not a feature flag
sections.heading_zh: 能力范围应是一组同时成立的条件

sections.heading: Identity continuity and failure semantics determine freshness
sections.heading_zh: 身份连续性与失败语义决定证据是否仍然有效

sections.heading: Better provenance is not complete authorization
sections.heading_zh: 更好的来源不等于完整授权

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged Codex implementation removes caller-supplied entitlement context before producing host-owned context.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 Codex 实现会先移除调用方提供的权限上下文，再生成宿主拥有的上下文。

evidenceClaims.claim: Verified context is injected only when the documented conjunction of entitlement, plugin, environment, transport, mutability and argument predicates holds.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 只有声明的权限、插件、环境、传输、可变性与参数条件全部成立时，核验上下文才会注入。

evidenceClaims.claim: The lookup is time- and size-bounded, disables redirects and checks account identity continuity.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 访问查询具有时间和大小上限，禁止重定向，并检查账户身份连续性。

evidenceClaims.claim: Unverifiable or inconsistent conditions produce host-generated unknown with empty grants instead of preserving caller authority.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 无法核验或不一致的情况会产生宿主生成的 unknown 与空授权，而不会保留调用方权限。

evidenceClaims.claim: The authority issuer and the requesting capability should remain separate.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 权限证据签发方与提出请求的能力应保持分离。

evidenceClaims.claim: Verified evidence should cross only an explicitly scoped capability edge and fail closed when continuity cannot be established.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已核验证据只能跨越显式限定的能力边界；无法建立连续性时应失败关闭。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns a general authority-evidence broker boundary.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already supplies the complete evidence-bounded architecture pattern.

candidates.researchQuestion: When may an invoked skill contribute authorization evidence without letting repository text or forged paths impersonate user intent?
candidates.title: A Trusted Path Proves Provenance, Not Approval
candidates.title_zh: 可信路径证明来源，不等于批准
candidates.coreProposition: An invoked skill should influence authorization only after the host records the actual invocation and verifies resource provenance against an authority-owned trusted root; canonical location proves a bounded origin under that trust model, not content identity, semantic safety, immutability or contemporaneous user approval.

sections.heading: Prove the invocation occurred before interpreting it
sections.heading_zh: 先证明“发生过调用”，再讨论调用意味着什么

sections.heading: Canonical trusted roots answer an origin question
sections.heading_zh: 规范化可信根解决的是来源问题

sections.heading: Path-only evidence reduces risk and loses content identity
sections.heading_zh: 路径证据收缩风险，也牺牲内容身份

sections.heading: Five evidence dimensions must not substitute for one another
sections.heading_zh: 五种证据不能互相替代

sections.heading: Design the record for audit and revocation
sections.heading_zh: 面向审计与撤销的下一步

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged Guardian v2 implementation records an invoked skill only after host resolution through configured trusted user roots.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 Guardian v2 实现只有在宿主通过配置的用户可信根解析资源后，才会记录技能调用。

evidenceClaims.claim: Canonicalization and real-file containment keep repository skills and symlink escapes outside the demonstrated trusted path.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 规范化和真实文件包含检查，使仓库技能与符号链接逃逸无法进入已展示的可信路径。

evidenceClaims.claim: Guardian receives a bounded deduplicated list of verified canonical paths rather than privileged full skill bodies.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Guardian 接收有界、去重的已核验规范化路径列表，而不是提升完整技能正文的权限。

evidenceClaims.claim: Maintainer tests cover trusted invocations, repository forgery, symlink escape, deduplication and evidence limits.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 维护者测试覆盖可信调用、仓库伪造、符号链接逃逸、去重和证据上限。

evidenceClaims.claim: Authorization evidence should begin with host-observed occurrence and host-verified provenance, not extension assertions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 授权证据应从宿主观察到的发生事实和宿主核验的来源开始，而不能从扩展自我声明开始。

evidenceClaims.claim: Location provenance cannot substitute for content identity, semantic safety, immutability or current approval.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 位置来源不能替代内容身份、语义安全、不可变性或当前批准。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general extension provenance and authorization evidence.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already provides the complete multi-dimensional evidence model; a separate edition would repeat it.
